model.summary: Model favors JAX by 8.3 points (78% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (JAX +3.7), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (JAX +2.2), Rest days (home minus away) (JAX +1.5). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.
